title: About the SGW-U down in the CUPS environment hundreds of kilometers away

labels.name: Help Wanted
labels.description: Maintainers are not working on this issue so community help is wanted.

body:
Hi @acetcom 

I'm sorry for the lack of information. If you know anything, I would be very glad if you could let me know.

I tried running EPC between the C-Plane and U-Plane that are several hundred kilometers apart.
They are connected with dedicated network.

As a result, U-Plane's SGW-U was down after 5 days from startup. The log at that time is as follows.

**Open5GS version is v2.4.9-52-gc716a12.**
```
09/10 21:20:58.063: [pfcp] WARNING: [44797] LOCAL  No Reponse. Give up! for step 1 type 1 peer [192.168.67.30]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:613)
09/10 21:20:58.068: [sgwu] WARNING: No Heartbeat from SGW-C [192.168.67.30]:8805 (../src/sgwu/pfcp-sm.c:251)
09/10 21:20:58.069: [sgwu] INFO: PFCP de-associated (../src/sgwu/pfcp-sm.c:173)
09/10 21:21:13.277: [event] FATAL: ogs_pool_alloc() failed (../lib/core/ogs-timer.c:87)
09/10 21:21:13.278: [pfcp] FATAL: ogs_pfcp_xact_local_create: Assertion `xact->tm_response' failed. (../lib/pfcp/xact.c:95)
09/10 21:21:13.283: [core] FATAL: backtrace() returned 9 addresses (../lib/core/ogs-abort.c:37)
/root/open5gs/install/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogspfcp.so.2(ogs_pfcp_xact_local_create+0x2fc) [0x7f43e968e3f6]
./install/bin/open5gs-sgwud(+0x9ea5) [0x55a30dbe9ea5]
./install/bin/open5gs-sgwud(+0x7a95) [0x55a30dbe7a95]
/root/open5gs/install/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogscore.so.2(+0x24c43) [0x7f43e95b7c43]
./install/bin/open5gs-sgwud(+0x4d97) [0x55a30dbe4d97]
/root/open5gs/install/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libogscore.so.2(+0x117e5) [0x7f43e95a47e5]
/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpthread.so.0(+0x8609) [0x7f43e9547609]
/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(clone+0x43) [0x7f43e946c133]
```
As above, I got the error `FATAL: ogs_pool_alloc() failed`.
Could you think of any parameters that should be changed as a countermeasure against memory shortage?

If there seems to be too little information, I would like to get the log again.

Best regards,

--Shigeru
